services.name: Optimizer storefront SEO and launch checklist
owner: Commerce Optimizer + AEM Sites with Edge Delivery Services
services.scope: Run the launch checklist for your client's Optimizer storefront on Edge Delivery Services. Verify metadata, redirects and indexing in staging, test product discovery and the cart and checkout hand-off to the commerce backend, and document the DNS, CDN and publishing sequence and rollback plan.
services.adobe_quote: Complete these steps before production traffic reaches your Adobe Commerce Storefront (EDS).

source.title: Experience League: Adobe Commerce Storefront launch checklist

connection_how: Adobe's Commerce storefront on Edge Delivery Services runs on Commerce Optimizer: its ready-made storefront parts ask Optimizer for catalog, search and recommendations, while the commerce platform behind it keeps cart, checkout and accounts. The storefront comes with the Optimizer package, not with Optimizer Headless.
product_facts: The commerce backend owns cart, checkout, accounts and orders.

services.name: Optimizer storefront events to Experience Platform
owner: Commerce Optimizer + AEM Sites with Edge Delivery Services
services.scope: Configure your client's Adobe organization and datastream on the Optimizer storefront and connect the client's consent platform. Test product views and cart actions and validate purchase events where the checkout integration emits them. Verify the agreed events reach the Experience Platform dataset.
services.adobe_quote: This integration allows your storefront to send commerce events (product views, purchases, cart actions) directly to the Experience Platform Edge Network
